options.name: account_id
options.description: ID of the account the service ID belongs to.

options.name: apikey
options.description: Parameters for the API key in the Create service Id V1 REST request.

options.name: description
options.description:
The optional description of the Service Id.
The 'description' property is only available if a description was provided during a create of a Service Id.

options.name: entity_lock
options.description: Indicates if the service ID is locked for further write operations. False by default.

options.name: id
options.description: Unique ID of the service ID.

options.name: if_match
options.description:
Version of the service ID to be updated.
Specify the version that you retrieved as entity_tag (ETag header) when reading the service ID.
This value helps identifying parallel usage of this API. Pass * to indicate to update any version available. This might result in stale updates.

options.name: include_activity
options.description:
Defines if the entity's activity is included in the response.
Retrieving activity data is an expensive operation, so please only request this when needed.

options.name: include_history
options.description: Defines if the entity history is included in the response.

options.name: name
options.description:
Name of the Service Id. The name is not checked for uniqueness.
Therefore multiple names with the same value can exist. Access is done via the UUID of the Service Id.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: unique_instance_crns
options.description: Optional list of CRNs (string array) which point to the services connected to the service ID.
